How do I reset the Model X10 controller to factory settings?
To restore factory settings on the X10 controller, hold the reset button for ten seconds until the status light blinks amber.
The X10 controller status light is green during normal operation and red after a power fault.
What is the maximum operating temperature of the X10 controller?
The X10 controller operates from -20 to 55 degrees Celsius; above 55 degrees it reduces its clock rate.
Store spare X10 controllers in their sealed bags between -40 and 70 degrees Celsius.
Which fuse rating does the PS-4 power supply use?
The PS-4 power supply is protected by a 6.3 A slow-blow fuse in the holder beside the inlet.
The PS-4 power supply accepts 100 to 240 V AC at 50 or 60 Hz.
How often should the air filter of cabinet C2 be replaced?
Replace the cabinet C2 air filter every six months, or every three months at dusty sites.
Cabinet C2 has two fans that run at full speed above 40 degrees Celsius.
What torque is specified for the antenna mounting bolts?
Tighten the antenna mounting bolts to 25 newton-metres with a calibrated torque wrench.
Antenna mounting brackets are made of hot-dip galvanized steel.
How do I update the firmware of the R7 radio?
Upload the signed firmware image through the R7 web console under Maintenance, then reboot the radio.
The R7 radio web console listens on port 443 and requires an administrator account.
What does a flashing red ALM light mean on the R7 radio?
A flashing red ALM light on the R7 radio means the transmit power amplifier has shut down because of high reflected power.
The R7 radio has four front-panel lights: PWR, LINK, ALM and ACT.
What cable length is allowed between the R7 radio and its antenna?
Use at most 3 metres of half-inch coaxial cable between the R7 radio and the antenna to keep losses below 0.5 dB.
Half-inch coaxial cable has a minimum bending radius of 125 millimetres.
How is the battery bank of cabinet C2 tested?
Run the monthly discharge test from the C2 controller menu; the bank passes if it holds the load for 30 minutes.
The C2 battery bank uses twelve sealed lead-acid cells of 2 V each.
Which grounding conductor size is required for cabinet C2?
Bond cabinet C2 to the site ground bar with a green-yellow copper conductor of at least 16 square millimetres.
The site ground bar is mounted at the cable entry point of the shelter.
How do I replace a fan module in cabinet C2?
Loosen the two captive screws, slide the fan module out and insert the new one; it can be replaced with the cabinet powered.
Each fan module in cabinet C2 draws 12 W at full speed.
What is the default IP address of the X10 controller?
The X10 controller ships with the management address 192.168.10.1 on its MGMT port.
The X10 controller supports SNMPv3 and syslog over TLS.
How do I export the alarm log of the X10 controller?
Select Logs, then Export, in the X10 console to download the alarm log as a CSV file.
The X10 controller keeps up to 10,000 alarm entries before overwriting the oldest.
What clearance is needed in front of cabinet C2?
Leave at least 800 millimetres of free space in front of cabinet C2 so the door opens fully for service.
Cabinet C2 is 600 millimetres wide and 2,000 millimetres tall.
How is the PS-4 power supply hot-swapped?
Switch off the PS-4 breaker, release the latch and pull the module; the second PS-4 carries the load during the swap.
Two PS-4 power supplies share the load equally in normal operation.
Which optical modules does the X10 controller accept?
The X10 controller accepts 10G SFP+ LR and SR modules from its approved list; other modules raise a warning.
Clean the fiber connectors with a one-click cleaner before inserting them.
How long does the R7 radio take to boot?
After power-on, the R7 radio takes about 90 seconds to boot and establish its link.
The R7 radio draws 45 W on average and 60 W at peak.
What is the weight of the R7 radio?
The R7 radio weighs 6.5 kilograms without its mounting bracket.
The R7 radio is rated IP65 against dust and water jets.
How do I set the time zone of the X10 controller?
Set the time zone under System, then Clock, in the X10 console; the controller keeps UTC internally.
The X10 controller synchronizes its clock with up to three NTP servers.
What should be checked after a lightning strike at the site?
After a lightning strike, inspect the surge protectors of cabinet C2 and replace any whose indicator window shows red.
Lightning rods on the tower are inspected once a year by the structure contractor.
